name: ci-failure
instruction: Triage this failed CI run. Read the failing job's log excerpt and name the actual cause, not the symptom. A failure on the default branch is more serious than one on a branch. If the same job has failed this way before, it is a regression, not a bug.
filter_instruction: Run only when a workflow run has completed with conclusion 'failure' or 'timed_out'. Skip successes, cancellations, skipped runs, re-run requests still in progress, and any run on a branch whose name starts with 'dependabot/' or 'renovate/'.
